thread:
talia: Quick question — my spouse had a dentist appointment today and the office said they couldn't find our family plan in their system. They asked for payment and wouldn't accept the PDF on my phone. Paid $210 out of pocket. What's the easiest way to get reimbursed and avoid this again?

iris (People Ops): Sorry that happened. Short checklist: 1) ask the dental office for an itemized receipt (procedure codes or at least tooth/service line, date, provider name, tax ID/NPI if they have it), 2) download the insurer PDF ID card from the member portal (preferred over screenshots), 3) submit an out-of-pocket claim to the insurer and cc benefits@redwood.com so we can escalate if it stalls.

talia: The receipt just says "dental services" and a total. They said their billing system is separate and won't add CDT codes unless requested.

broker-sam: Call the clinic billing and request an "itemized statement" or a dental claim form (ADA form/code list). Ask them to include their billing tax ID or NPI — that really helps claims processing. If they won't provide codes, the date, service description, and provider name usually suffices for initial submission.

talia: If insurer processes as out-of-network, will I get full reimbursement? Our plan usually has in-network rates for the dentist.

iris (People Ops): If provider is in-network but billed incorrectly, insurer should reprocess and reimburse the difference. If provider is truly out-of-network, reimbursement follows the plan's OON dental terms (coinsurance/allowed amount). We'll review the EOB and help file an appeal or provider-directory dispute if needed. Typical timeframe: insurer ack 5-10 business days, EOB 2-4 weeks.

insurer-bot: Digital ID available: https://portal.insurer/ids/332211445.pdf :card_file_box: (expires 2027-05-01)

broker-sam: Pro tip: ask the clinic for a signed treatment record or CDT list if they refuse an itemized bill. That plus the receipt helps. Also request expedited mailing of a paper card via the insurer portal if you need one for future visits.

talia: OK sent clinic an itemized request and submitted the claim to claims@insurer.example with receipt + digital ID, cc'd benefits@redwood.com. Thanks.

iris (People Ops): Got it — we'll monitor and ping the broker if it doesn't move in two weeks. Keep any phone notes (rep name, time) in case we need to escalate. :thumbsup:

talia: Thanks all — will update here once I get the EOB.
